<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read the input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Get indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness for each indicator
missingness_data = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / len(df)
    kept = 1 if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 0
    missingness_data.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create missingness report DataFrame
missingness_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_data)

# Write missingness report
missingness_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Select kept indicators
kept_indicators = [col for col in indicator_cols if missingness_df[missingness_df['indicator'] == col]['kept'].iloc[0] == 1]

# Create selected matrix
selected_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators
selected_df = df[selected_cols]

# Write selected matrix
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
